_meta.what: Which class contexts are user-facing, and under what name.
_meta.why: The class-context records are research output. Some of them are notes the researching agent wrote to whoever curates next — a class whose display name is 'Data integrity issues in source list' or ends 'miscategorized in this group' is a finding about the source data, not a class a reader belongs to. Those are excluded from the build rather than filtered in the app, so nothing downstream has to know.
_meta.name: An override for a slug whose authored display name is a bucket label rather than a class. Omit to keep the authored one.
_meta.membership: A compound written up in one class's research file sometimes carries another class's id — 2C-B is tagged 'amphetamine-monoamine-releasers' with high confidence in the amphetamine file, and carries no class at all in the phenethylamine-psychedelics file where it belongs. So a membership is kept only when the substance's own resolved category agrees with the class's dominant one, or the pair is listed in `compatible_categories`. A category of 'Other' or none cannot disagree, so those are kept — which is the long tail, and the case the class card is most useful for. `keep` overrides a drop for a verified member.

name.generic-tryptamine-NPS-no-human-data: Tryptamines with no published human pharmacology
